name: defense
description: Making effort to preserve the state of things relating to yourself or important social contact.
perceptions: Someone or something is trying to change the state of things.
I prefer things the way they are.

variations.name: defending territory and assets
variations.description: Effort to maintain land or other resources intact and within your control. The attacker may be a person, a group, animals, or natural forces.
perceptions: Someone or something is trying to degrade or remove something that's mine.
I need to protect these things.

variations.name: defending life and health
variations.description: Taking steps to keep yourself or someone else safe from perceived threats ranging from minor illness to mortal danger.
perceptions: Someone or something is trying to harm me or someone important to me.

variations.name: defending reputation
variations.description: Making effort to prevent a change in social status from perceived threats. These actions may protect yourself or an important other.
perceptions: Someone or something is trying to harm an important social status.

guidance.description: People make judgments about you based on what they find about you on the internet. So, you need to protect your reputation, especially on social media.
